qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global monopoly on extreme ultraviolet (EUV) photolithography protected by proprietary optics (Zeiss exclusive partnership), laser-produced plasma source IP, and thousands of patents. Extraordinary pricing power demonstrated by EUV tool ASPs scaling from €120M to >€350M for High-NA while maintaining >51% gross margins and ~98% median GAAP ROIC. Primary risks: geopolitical export curbs on shipments to China and customer concentration (TSMC, Samsung, Intel).
qualitative.note: Unassailable global commercial monopoly on EUV lithography machines essential for all leading-edge semiconductor manufacturing. Unprecedented pricing power with tool ASPs climbing from €120M to >€350M for High-NA tools and 98%+ median GAAP ROIC. Sovereign semiconductor reshoring and AI computing act as massive secular catalysts. Fortress balance sheet with >€10B net cash. [5-10Y g: litho wafer demand & EUV/High-NA intensity 8.0% + tool ASP/service mix 2.0% + margin 0.5% + buybacks 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year median GAAP ROIC is 98.6% (operating tangible ROIC >150%). Gross margin has consistently maintained 51-53% and EBIT margins ~35%. Revenue expanded from €21.17B in 2022 to €32.67B in 2025, with Owner EPS reaching a record peak of €24.71 in 2025. Owner FCF was €11.43B in 2025 (119% conversion of Net Income; multi-year FCF conversion 110.7%). Balance sheet holds €12.92B in cash against €2.71B in long-term debt (net cash of €10.21B), with interest coverage of ~97x. Monopolistic market share in EUV with multi-year backlog and ~25% high-margin installed base recurring service revenue.
